resources.string: APRS messages over a KISS link. Only routes RadiCodex can reach are offered; a radio without APRS/KISS is never simulated. Transmitting requires an amateur radio licence.
Pick a link, connect it and enter your callsign. Every send is transmitted over RF and asks for confirmation.

EXTERNAL TNC (e.g. Direwolf or a TNC bridge): RadiCodex only speaks KISS over an unencrypted TCP socket to the host and port you enter. The radio is handled by that TNC, not by the app; use it only on a trusted network.
Link closed by the other end
APRS TX beacon only, no KISS or reception

This message will be transmitted over radio frequency (RF).

From: %1$s
To: %2$s
Text: %3$s

Without an ack it is resent up to 3 times every 30 s.

%4$s

RT-950 Pro: a successful BLE write does NOT prove RF transmission; confirm with a second receiver. Per the lalmonte/radiochat-aprs@9c7b092 README some firmware accepts the KISS write without keying the PTT; erkanz/radtel-RT950PRO@51c84d4 reports TX working with a patched v0.29.
External TNC: what is transmitted depends on that TNC and its radio; RadiCodex cannot confirm it.
The frame exceeds this link\'s AX.25 limits (max %1$d AX.25 bytes, %2$d digipeaters, %3$d info bytes)
The TCP port must be between 1 and 65535
Could not connect to the TNC at %1$s
The TCP link to the TNC is closed
BLE KISS mode: the ff31 unlock (CPS programming mode) is not sent and each frame goes in ONE write. Choose where it is written; if FF31 does not transmit, try FFE1.
Write to FFE1 (like the nicsure bridge)
\"RTX1\" prefix (erkanz-patched firmware only; layout after it unverified)
The KISS frame (%1$d bytes) does not fit in one BLE write (max %2$d bytes at the negotiated MTU); it is not split

Incident 2026-11-12: sending an APRS message from RadiCodex over BLE KISS froze the firmware of an RT-950 Pro.

SP3ARK/Radtel-950-Pro-Bluetooth-Programmator@a8bb41a (README) documents a bug: after any Bluetooth read or write the radio stops sending APRS frames until it is restarted.

If the radio freezes, power cycle it (switch it off and on).
RT-950 Pro: receive only. Sending, automatic acks and resends are off unless you enable “Experimental TX” under Advanced.
Sending over the RT-950 Pro is disabled (firmware freeze risk); enable it under Advanced at your own risk
The BLE link to the RT-950 Pro is closed
The last clone, backup or write session is more recent than the last radio power cycle. Switch the radio off and on before using KISS.
